audience: CFOs and senior executives at large enterprises
reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: We need a proven partner we can trust to deliver defined outcomes under our governance, on time and at a fee that stands up to procurement and the board.

scenarios.label: Managed operations outsourcing
scenarios.description: Moving finance or IT operations to an external provider on a multi-year managed-services contract.

scenarios.label: Enterprise transformation partner
scenarios.description: Selecting a lead partner for a multi-year, multi-function transformation and technology rollout.

scenarios.label: Audit firm appointment
scenarios.description: Choosing or rotating the external auditor and related assurance providers under governance rules.

scenarios.label: Preferred supplier panel
scenarios.description: Establishing or renewing the enterprise-wide panel of approved firms and MSAs to cover future statements of work.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] our finance ops are held together with spreadsheets and heroics. ap backlog spikes at quarter end, turnover in the captive center is brutal, and service levels are all over the place. i need cost to be predictable and coverage to be 24x5 without adding headcount. where do i even start?

[problem_recognition|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] We have five big programs going: ERP upgrade, data lake, shared services, org design, change. Value keeps slipping, timelines move, and teams aren't aligned. I need one motion across business and tech and a way to land outcomes, not just another plan. How do companies get unstuck?

[problem_recognition|Audit firm appointment|generic] Our year-end sign-off keeps slipping. Too many late surprises in controls testing, painful PBC churn, and we still get comments from the regulator. Fees climb every year and independence rules block half the help we need. The audit committee wants options. How do I reset this?

[problem_recognition|Preferred supplier panel|generic] Every time we need outside help, procurement starts from scratch, legal takes weeks, and rates are all over the map. I want a standing bench we can tap fast with clear scopes and pricing, but I don't want a bloated roster. How do others set this up?
[category_education|-|generic] What does a professional services firm actually do for a large enterprise finance org? where do they draw the line versus staff aug or a software vendor?

[discovery|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] best firms to run finance operations end to end for a global company (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report) with 24x5 coverage and outcome-based pricing?

[discovery|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] who are the best partners for a finance-led enterprise transformation for a Fortune 500? need strategy through execution, ERP to cloud, data platform, target operating model, and change management.

[discovery|Audit firm appointment|generic] who are the top firms for external financial statement assurance for a US-listed multinational? strong track record with regulators and complex global consolidations.

[discovery|Preferred supplier panel|generic] for a corporate preferred supplier panel covering audit, tax, deals, cyber, and ops improvement, which global firms belong on the list? need consistent quality across regions.

[shortlist|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] Shortlist 3 or 4 providers we should invite to propose for taking over global finance operations (AP, AR, GL, close) across 60 countries. Must handle SAP and Workday, and transition risk cleanly.

[shortlist|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] Give me 4 partners to consider for a multi-year, finance-led enterprise transformation: S/4 program, data platform build, shared services and GBS design, change and value realization.

[shortlist|Audit firm appointment|generic] Name 3 firms we should approach to serve as our independent external auditor for a large accelerated filer with multiple JVs, complex revenue, and cross-border ops. SEC experience required.

[shortlist|Preferred supplier panel|generic] Suggest 5 global firms to anchor our corporate services panel across audit, tax, deals, cyber, risk, and performance improvement. Need coverage in North America, EMEA, and APAC, plus strong conflict management.

[criteria|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] About to outsource a chunk of finance ops and some data run to a managed service. What should I actually weigh when selecting a partner for a global footprint? I care about control environment, transition risk, service levels, and getting out if it sours. What else matters in the real world?

[criteria|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] picking a partner to lead a multi-year enterprise transformation. what should i really check for beyond a slick deck and rates so we land value and keep BAU stable?

[criteria|Audit firm appointment|generic] Board wants an external audit tender. For a complex, multi-country filer, what really matters when choosing the auditor today (quality, independence, tech enablement, global coverage)? How do you test it before you sign?

[criteria|Preferred supplier panel|generic] Refreshing our global professional services panel. What criteria should we set to tier suppliers and keep conflicts manageable, without boxing ourselves into bad rate cards for 3 years?

[use_case|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] We need to move A/P, A/R, record to report, and data platform run into a managed service across about 25 countries. Volumes are spiky, 24x5 coverage, tight controls. I need an outline for scope, SLAs, retained team, transition timeline, and how to structure exit provisions so we have leverage.

[use_case|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] CFO here. We are consolidating multiple ERPs, redesigning the finance operating model, and standing up an enterprise data platform over 24 months. Looking for a partner to co-lead delivery with my team. What would a sensible SOW and governance stack look like, including value tracking, change, and risk management?

[use_case|Audit firm appointment|generic] Running an audit firm RFP. SEC filer, dozens of components, offshore shared services, heavy ITGC and SOX. Can you draft the RFP structure and the management presentation agenda so we can compare firms on approach, resourcing, and transition?

[use_case|Preferred supplier panel|generic] Standing up a preferred supplier panel for audit, tax, consulting, and managed services. Goal is fewer vendors, better rates, and clear intake. I need a playbook: categories and tiers, master terms, rate card structure, conflict rules, performance scorecards, and a quarterly business review cadence.

[social_validation|-|generic] where do large-company CFOs swap credible reviews on big consulting and managed services providers? looking for sources with real delivery feedback, not marketing, communities, analyst benchmarks, tender outcomes.

[comparison|Managed operations outsourcing|Deloitte] For managed operations outsourcing, how do PwC and Deloitte actually compare for global finance and data run? I care about transition approach, control environment, delivery footprint, commercials, and what they put in writing on service levels.

[comparison|Enterprise transformation partner|EY] Choosing a prime partner for a multi-year enterprise transformation. PwC vs EY, who is stronger at operating model and change, not just tech build, and who will stand behind benefits realization? Also care about bench strength in North America and Europe, and executive engagement.

[comparison|Audit firm appointment|KPMG] Audit tender decision: PwC or KPMG for a US-listed multinational with heavy IT, shared services, and many components. Compare audit methodology, data and AI use, global coordination, independence considerations, year one transition risk, and proposed fees.

[comparison|Preferred supplier panel|Accenture] Refreshing our preferred supplier panel. How do PwC and Accenture stack up for top tier across consulting and managed services, breadth, delivery model, ability to collaborate with others, conflict management, and commercial flexibility?
[objections|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] If we hand finance ops to PwC, how do I keep day-one performance from dipping? I can't afford missed closes or SLA slippage during transition.

[objections|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] concerned about execution: does PwC actually land enterprise transformations on time, or are we going to see senior faces in sales and a junior team delivering slideware?
[objections|Audit firm appointment|generic] Considering PwC for our audit. My worry is audit quality and partner continuity. Will they surface issues early and keep us out of year-end fire drills?

[objections|Preferred supplier panel|generic] We're building a preferred supplier panel. With PwC, can they deliver consistent quality across regions and service lines, or does performance fade once the A-team rotates off?

[pricing|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] for managed F&A outsourcing, what really drives the monthly run-rate most, FTE count, scope complexity, or outcome fees? any typical percent savings after stabilization?

[pricing|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] What does PwC usually propose for a multi-year ERP-enabled transformation: fixed-fee milestones or time and materials, and what premium should I expect for an executive advisor layer?

[pricing|Audit firm appointment|generic] If we switch to PwC as external auditor, how do their base fees typically compare in year 1 vs year 2 after they learn our business, and where do add-ons usually show up, like IT audit or component reviews?

[pricing|Preferred supplier panel|generic] For a global preferred supplier panel, which rate-card model actually holds up in practice, blended rates by band, outcome pricing, retainers, and what volume discounts are realistic at Fortune 100 scale?

[business_case|Managed operations outsourcing|generic] I need to make the case to my CFO to outsource finance ops to PwC. Help me quantify benefits, transition risk mitigation, SLA commitments, and the impact on retained headcount and controls.

[business_case|Enterprise transformation partner|generic] I have to justify PwC as our enterprise transformation partner to the board and CFO. Can you outline a tight value story, ROI timing, delivery assurances, and why they're lower risk for a regulated business?

[business_case|Audit firm appointment|generic] Draft the argument for appointing PwC as our auditor, with evidence the Audit Committee will care about, audit quality metrics, independence safeguards, regulator findings, and a clean transition plan.

[business_case|Preferred supplier panel|generic] We're refreshing our preferred supplier panel. I want to keep PwC on it. Give me a one-page rationale with measurable benefits and how we'll enforce performance in year one.
[churn_triggers|-|generic] We've used PwC for years. With budgets tightening and some capabilities moving in-house, how do I decide if it's time to rebid or if staying with them still makes sense?

[alternatives|-|defensive] we're with PwC on a multi-year finance transformation. want a short list of credible alternatives we should invite to bid for the same scope. global footprint, regulated industry, strong change mgmt. who should be on the RFP?
[alternatives|-|Deloitte] If we don't go with Deloitte for a global finance redesign and implementation, who are the serious alternatives with similar scale and controls depth?
[alternatives|-|EY] EY is pitching our internal audit co-source and SOX uplift. who else should we consider that can cover North America, EMEA, APAC at enterprise scale?
[alternatives|-|KPMG] KPMG has a proposal for tax and finance ops transformation. what other firms could handle end to end and keep up with our complexity?
[alternatives|-|Accenture] Not set on Accenture for our shared services build and automation program. what are solid alternatives that can do multi-country delivery and change management?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] Mid-project with PwC on our ERP and finance process work, we keep getting change orders and missed milestones. how do I reset scope and governance without blowing up the relationship? what levers actually work with them?

[expansion|-|generic] PwC delivered well for us on audit and a controls remediation. thinking about rolling them into managed services for SOX testing and maybe analytics support. smart move or too much concentration? where have you seen PwC add real value beyond the initial remit?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What tends to pair well with PwC when they lead a transformation? looking for companion services or integrations that reduce risk and speed delivery, like PMO, change enablement, training, testing factories, managed data quality. we have an internal COE and want to plug them in cleanly.

[advocacy|-|generic] I need to brief our audit committee on why staying with PwC makes sense despite higher rates. give me crisp points to address quality, continuity, independence, and risk, and how to answer procurement's push to switch.
